items.text: Sendhil Revuluri, former vice president of the Chicago Board of Education, suspended his campaign for board president in September 2026 but remains on the ballot.

sentences.text: Sendhil Revuluri, former vice president of the Chicago Board of Education, suspended his campaign for board president in September 2026 but remains on the ballot.

items.text: A former math teacher, he was a founding teacher at a public school in New York and served on a Local School Council. He was also associate director of the Suburban Cook County Mathematics Initiative. In his campaign, he proposed creating an evaluation process for the superintendent and closing very small schools to move students into schools with more classes and programs. As board vice president, his campaign says he led the Finance and Audit Committee and asked the district to publicly report its fiscal outlook.
